sentences.text:
Heard on Ia No.2582 of 2025 , first application under Section 430 (1) of Bhartiya Nagarik Suraksha
Sanhita, 2023 [389 (1) of Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973] for suspension of jail sentence and
grant of bail moved on behalf of appellant - Darasingh S/o Mohansingh Awasiya .

Vide judgment of conviction and order of sentence dated 30.01.2025 passed in Special Sessions Trial No.29 of 2024 by the learned Special Judge (under POCSO Act) and First Additional Sessions Judge, Barwani, District Barwani (MP), the present appellant has been convicted under Sections 366 (A) and 376 (3) of Indian Penal Code, 1860 and also under Section 5-L read with Section 6 of Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012 and respectively sentenced to undergo five years rigorous imprisonment with fine of Rs.2,000/-, twenty years rigorous imprisonment with fine of Rs.5,000/- and twenty years rigorous imprisonment with fine of Rs.5,000/- along with default stipulations.

entities.text: Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: The allegation against the appellant is that he had abducted the minor girl and exploited her sexually for about 1 and 1/2 months.
Learned counsel for the appellant argued that as per the statement of 2 CRA-2019-2025 the prosecutrix, there is no allegation of sexual exploitation by the present appellant.
The prosecutrix remained in the custody of the present appellant for about one and half months.
At the time of the incident, the age of the prosecutrix is fifteen years and six months, as per scholar register; and the DNA report is also not conclusive.

The appellant has already remained in jail for about two months,
during trial.
Learned counsel for the appellant prays for grant of suspension of jail sentence and releasing the appellant on bail.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the respondent / State opposed the prayer on the ground that the age of the prosecutrix is minor.

After hearing learned counsel for parties and taking into consideration the statement of the prosecutrix, this Court finds that she had not made any allegations of sexual relationship with the appellant.
Apart from that, DNA report is also not conclusive in the present case.
The prosecution has failed to prove the source of age of the prosecutrix in the scholar register.

In view of aforesaid and considering the fact that the appellant was on bail during trial and it is not the case of the respondent - State that there was any misuse of the liberty, as well as the fact that the appeal is of the year 2025 and the final hearing of the appeal may take time, therefore, we are of the view that the present application deserves to be allowed.
Considering the same, the present application is allowed.

The jail sentence of appellant - Darasingh S/o Mohansingh Awasiya is suspended and he be released on bail upon his depositing the fine amount, if not already deposited, and on furnishing a bail bond of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty 3 CRA-2019-2025 Thousand Only) with one surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the Trial Court for his appearance before the Registry of this Court on 11/11/2025 and on subsequent dates as may be fixed in this behalf by the Registry.
Certified copy as per rules.
(VIJAY KUMAR SHUKLA) (BINOD KUMAR DWI  JUDGE JUDGE
